author.role: PhD (c), Wellness Enthusiast and Co-Founder, COO at Biohackers World

intro:
The Biohackers World Conference & Expo, which took place in Austin on April 6-7, 2024, proved to be a groundbreaking and transformative gathering that united wellness enthusiasts, industry leaders, and health entrepreneurs in one venue. The primary focus of the event was on disseminating scientific knowledge and strategies for optimizing health that form a robust foundation for well-being.

Featuring over 25 speakers and 22 wellness companies in the expo hall, attendees had the chance to connect with peers, forge new friendships, and gain insights from top experts in the wellness industry.

The host of the Biohackers World | Conference & Expo, [Elias Arjan](https://www.biohackers.world/events/austin2024?speaker=elias-arjan), Founder/CEO | Evidence Based Wellness Advocate, set the tone for the event with an opening speech that highlighted the importance of optimizing health through scientific methods and adopting a personalized approach to wellness

blocks.text: Day One: Unlocking the Secrets of Optimal Health

The inaugural day at the Biohackers World | Conference & Expo in Austin opened with a grand introduction by [**Mick Safron**](https://www.biohackers.world/events/austin2024?speaker=mick-safron), Founder and CEO, who set an invigorating tone for the event. The sessions commenced with [**Elias Arjan**](https://www.biohackers.world/events/austin2024?speaker=elias-arjan) discussing “The Evolution of Biohacking,” where he demystified the movement from grassroots to mainstream. [**Zane Griggs**](https://www.biohackers.world/events/austin2024?speaker=zane-griggs)**,** Fitness & Longevity Coach, then guided attendees through “Building Muscle After 40,” highlighting the critical role of muscle in longevity.

[**Ted Baker**](https://www.biohackers.world/events/austin2024?speaker=ted-baker)**,** Executive Advisor to DRC Ventures (The Root Brand), provided insights into holistic health with his talk “Addition By Subtraction,” emphasizing the power of detoxification and intentional living. The morning’s discussions culminated in a panel moderated by [**Zane Griggs**](https://www.biohackers.world/events/austin2024?speaker=zane-griggs), featuring experts like [**Barton Bryan**](https://www.biohackers.world/events/austin2024?speaker=Barton-Bryan)**,** Mid-Life Growth Expert, Personal Trainer and Podcast Host, [**Dr. Kyle Hardwick**](https://www.biohackers.world/events/austin2024?speaker=dr-kyle-hardwick)**,** DC, Founder of Adjusted ATX Chiropractic Clinic, [**Kristin Weitzel**](https://www.biohackers.world/events/austin2024?speaker=kristin-weitzel)**,** Founder of SHERPA and Host of the Wellpower Podcast, and [**Dr. Jonathan Mendoza**](https://www.biohackers.world/events/austin2024?speaker=jonathan-mendoza), DC, RN, FNP-C, Owner of the Nurse Doza Clinic, who explored innovative approaches in supplementation and fitness for enhancing life quality.

In the afternoon, [**Kristin Weitzel**](https://www.biohackers.world/events/austin2024?speaker=kristin-weitzel) returned to explore the critical role of breath and cold exposure in “Shatter Your Limits: Why Breath and Cold Exposure is Imperative to Achieving Your Dreams” followed by [**Dr. Jonathan Mendoza**](https://www.biohackers.world/events/austin2024?speaker=jonathan-mendoza) who detailed methods for liver detoxification in “How to Detox the Liver for a Vibrant and Energetic Body.” [**Susan Bratton**](https://www.biohackers.world/events/austin2024?speaker=susan-bratton), Intimacy Expert To Millions, rounded out the day’s speeches with “Sexual Biohacking,” offering unique insights into enhancing sexual health.

The day concluded with a panel discussion on “Radiant from Within: Exploring the Secrets of Healthy Aging” led by [**Mollie Eastman**](https://www.biohackers.world/events/austin2024?speaker=mollie-eastman), Sleep Expert, Influencer, and including [**Melissa Bolona**](https://www.biohackers.world/events/austin2024?speaker=melissa-bolona), CEO & Founder of Beauty & the Broth, [**Dr. Sanober Doctor**](https://www.biohackers.world/events/austin2024?speaker=dr-sanober-doctor), MD, Founder of AGEnesis™: Holistic Aging Blueprint, [**Dr. Lauren Leiva**](https://www.biohackers.world/events/austin2024?speaker=lauren-leiva), DPT, Founder of The Exerscience Center, and [**Susan Bratton**](https://www.biohackers.world/events/austin2024?speaker=susan-bratton), which delved into age-defying wellness practices. The evening closed with a restorative yoga session by [**Dr. Lauren Leiva**](https://www.biohackers.world/events/austin2024?speaker=lauren-leiva), designed to integrate the day’s learnings and rejuvenate the spirit.

Day 1 of Biohackers World | Conference & Expo in Austin was a resounding success, leaving attendees inspired, enlightened, and eager for more. As the event continues, participants are gearing up for more groundbreaking insights and transformative experiences.
Day Two: Exploring the Future of Wellness at Biohackers World | Conference & Expo , Austin

Day Two of the Biohackers World in Austin deepened the exploration of advanced wellness strategies, providing attendees with an immersive experience in state-of-the-art biohacking techniques. The day began with a serene Morning Meditation session led by [**Jude Rosemond**](https://www.biohackers.world/events/austin2024?speaker=jude-rosemond), Meditation Guide & Artist, setting a focused tone.

[**Dr. Michael Ruscio**](https://www.biohackers.world/events/austin2024?speaker=dr-michael-ruscio), Naturopathic Practitioner, Doctor of Chiropractic, clinical researcher and author, opened the keynote sessions with an insightful exploration of the Gut–Thyroid Axis, emphasizing a gut-focused approach to resolving thyroid symptoms through evidence-based treatments and real case studies. Following him, [**Dr. Tim Harrigan**](https://www.biohackers.world/events/austin2024?speaker=dr-tim-harrigan), Doctor of Chiropractic, Health and Wellness Coach, discussed “Hormonal Harmony, Unlock your inner Femininity and Masculinity potential”, revealing natural and safe methods to balance hormones and enhance both femininity and masculinity.

[**Dr. William Pawluk**](https://www.biohackers.world/events/austin2024?speaker=dr-william-pawluk), Foremost authority on the use of Pulsed Electromagnetic Field (PEMF) therapy in North America, introduced attendees to the multifaceted benefits of PEMF Therapy, branding it as a “The “Swiss Army Knife” Health Solution That Belongs in Your Home: Supercharge Your Health with PEMF Therapy” health solution for home use, capable of enhancing general wellness at the cellular level.

The afternoon featured a robust panel discussion, “Biohack Your Health: Empowering Yourself with Advanced Strategies for Optimal Living,” moderated by [**Renee Belz**](https://www.biohackers.world/events/austin2024?speaker=renee-belz)**,** Health Optimization Coach & Co-Host of the Biohacker Babes Podcast. Panelists, including [**Chris Burres**](https://www.biohackers.world/events/austin2024?speaker=chris-burres), Chief Scientist and Co-Founder at MyVitalC, [**Kristen McAdams**](https://www.biohackers.world/events/austin2024?speaker=kristen-mcadams), Virtual Mental Health Counselor and Health Coach, [**Ted Baker**](https://www.biohackers.world/events/austin2024?speaker=ted-baker), [**Dr. William Pawluk**](https://www.biohackers.world/events/austin2024?speaker=dr-william-pawluk), and [**Adriana Alvarez**](https://www.biohackers.world/events/austin2024?speaker=adriana-alvarez), Head of Sales Healy World – Americas, shared advanced strategies for optimal living, highlighting personalized biohacking techniques that promote physical vitality and mental clarity.

[**Mollie Eastman**](https://www.biohackers.world/events/austin2024?speaker=mollie-eastman) then took the stage with speech “Unlocking the Power of Sleep”, providing scientific insights and practical biohacking tips that attendees could use to transform their sleep quality. [**Dr. Kyle Hardwick’s**](https://www.biohackers.world/events/austin2024?speaker=dr-kyle-hardwick) lecture “Upgrading Human Potential: Navigating Modern Technologies’ Impact On Physiology” examined how modern technologies affect physiology and offered strategies to harness human potential and mitigate tech-induced harm.

The day concluded with another powerful panel, “Biohack Your Way to Peak Health: Unveiling Secrets for Optimal Wellness,” where experts like [**Heather Gray**](https://www.biohackers.world/events/austin2024?speaker=heather-gray), FDN-P and Bioenergetic Practitioner, [**Baldomero Garza**](https://www.biohackers.world/events/austin2024?speaker=baldomero-garza), Founder & Chief Innovation Officer at MSW & Nurse Doza Clinic, Legacy Practice Modernization Consultant, [**CJ Finley**](https://www.biohackers.world/events/austin2024?speaker=cj-finley), Advisor in Health and Wellness Brands, and Host of the THRIVEONLIFE Podcast, [**Noah Huisman**](https://www.biohackers.world/events/austin2024?speaker=noah-huisman), Wellness Entrepreneur, Co-Owner of Squatch Frontier Fitness, and [**Dr. Devin Miles**](https://www.biohackers.world/events/austin2024?speaker=devin-miles)**,** Doctorate of Naturopathic Medicine, discussed secrets to achieving and maintaining peak health through biohacking.

Each session not only enriched the participants’ understanding of their health but also empowered them with actionable strategies to enhance their well-being, showcasing the Biohackers World’s commitment to advancing wellness through innovation.
Biohackers World Expo Hall: Health and Wellness Innovations

The Biohackers World Expo Hall, which took place in Austin on April 6-7, 2024, provided a vibrant display of the latest advancements in health, ecological products, and digital health technologies. Featuring 22 meticulously selected companies, the expo shed light on the future of health and wellness, introducing groundbreaking products and services aimed at enhancing both physical and mental well-being.

[**The ROOT Brands**](https://therootbrands.com/): Harnessing the power of nature, The ROOT Brands offered attendees a path to unlocking their true potential. Their innovative approach touched on the interconnectedness of the body, mind, and spirit in achieving optimal well-being.

[**Dr. Pawluk**](https://www.drpawluk.com/)**:** Harnessing advanced medical technologies, Dr. Pawluck offers expertise in PEMF Therapy and Magnetic Field Therapy, guiding patients towards healing through the best PEMF machines available.

[**Healy World**](https://us.healy.shop/)**:** Healy World introduces a unique, innovative wearable device that enhances holistic health and wellbeing. Already adopted in over 50 countries, Healy World promotes a balanced lifestyle through state-of-the-art technology.

[**Epic-T**](https://www.epicnutritional.com/)**:** Epic T empowers individuals with the essential knowledge and products needed to achieve optimal health and enhance testosterone levels, supporting a journey towards peak wellness.

[**Alimtox Wellnes**](https://www.alimtox.com/)**:** Alimtox champions natural detoxification with its Ion cell Cleanse, complementing a healthy, low-stress lifestyle for sustained energy and long-term wellness. This system offers a gentle yet effective purification support.

[**Seek Good Psyche**](https://seekgoodpsyche.com/): Good Psyche crafts immersive care products using medicinal plants and herbs, designed to elevate emotional and sexual wellbeing, enhancing your holistic health journey.

[**Pulse PEMF**](https://www.pulsepemf.com/)**:** Pulse PEMF redefines holistic care with safe solutions for enhancing energy, performance, and recovery. Integrating seamlessly into any wellness regimen, Pulse PEMF rejuvenates at the cellular level, enriching your health foundations.

[**Adjusted ATX**](https://adjustedatx.com/)**:** Adjusted ATX is committed to optimizing performance through specialized chiropractic care that enhances nervous system function, boosts mobility, and maximizes body potential for improved overall health.

[**MedicalExpo**](https://www.medicalexpo.com/): Medical Expo Supplies offers a comprehensive range of cutting-edge medical technology and equipment, ensuring top-tier solutions for today’s healthcare challenges.

[**PRUVN Research**](https://www.scientificresearch.group/)**:** PRUVN Research rigorously conducts scientific studies to substantiate the claims of leading wellness brands, ensuring their efficacy and credibility in the health industry.

The Biohackers World Expo Hall served as an energetic stage for innovative companies to exhibit their pioneering products and services. Participants departed the Expo Hall with an enhanced understanding of the vast potential within the health and wellness sector. As the event concluded, the influence of these progressive companies continued to resonate, motivating attendees to pursue their unique health and wellness paths. Keep an eye out for more updates and highlights from upcoming Biohackers World events, where innovation constantly redefines the future of well-being.

blocks.alt: Media Partners of Biohackers World in Austin

blocks.text: We express our heartfelt thanks to all our media partners for their unwavering support, dedication, and contributions to Biohackers World in Austin. Their collaboration was invaluable in making the event a resounding success, and we eagerly look forward to continuing our partnership in our shared mission to promote the latest advancements in biohacking and health optimization.

Warmly invite you to join us at our next event in Miami, scheduled for October 26-27, 2024. Don’t miss the opportunity to continue the journey of health optimization, connect with industry pioneers, and further expand your professional network.
